caption:
Luqman's advice to his son on prayer and patience

Luqman told his son to establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient with whatever befalls him. A short list, enough for a whole life. Start this Monday with your prayer on time.

Surah Luqman 31:17

Which part of Luqman's advice will you live by today?

#luqman #parentingadvice #patience #quranreels
